result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales rep list uses.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10020). I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with the same `CASE` priority ordering as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, and updated the Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `TicketsPerRegionTest` pass offline (`mvn -q -o test`, no output). I did not add a test for the new ordering, and I did not run your T-1…T-5 example directly. Nothing was committed.
